decision.reason: [ev-af8499647b78] is a one-line changelog entry. It says the `shared_store` and `shared_store_key_prefix` keys and their CLI flags were removed from the tsdb, boltdb shipper and compactor configs. That is enough for the subject and the change type. It does not give the full config paths or the exact flag names, so there is no precise exposure condition to build. It also does not say what happens to a config or command line that still sets these keys: startup failure, a parse error, or silently ignored. For those details it only points to PR 10840. The upgrade guide or the PR text is needed to settle applicability and consequence.
